assessments.statement: Knowledge pyramid has three layers: K_foundation (stable axioms), K_theory (working models), K_edge (live hypotheses)
assessments.assessment: Three-layer organization is a design implemented by the model, not a finding of external truth.

assessments.statement: Truth pressure formula: Π = E·P/Coh — evidence weight times plausibility divided by current coherence
assessments.assessment: Current coherence, per-block uncertainty and strain are different denominators in the corpus. A computable ratio needs an explicit version and construct-validation evidence.

assessments.statement: Invariant preservation — Theorem C1: the CASCADE update operator preserves the set of structural invariants across reorganization
assessments.assessment: The formal spine promises foundation membership preservation; the actual engine demotes an old foundation while retaining its record. Other structural invariants require separate statements.

assessments.statement: Grey Mode recovery is a complete closed negative-feedback regulator in code: its sensor (compute_psi_r), comparator (reentry_test, against an adaptive threshold) and actuator (recovery_cycle) sit in one class, and the actuator's output is the sensor's next input.
assessments.assessment: The source distinguishes feedback loops, open loops and the opt-in caller-policy regulator. Maintained tests exercise those contracts. Loop closure on specified numerical/text proxies does not establish external truth, ethical sensing or control robustness.

assessments.statement: CASCADE closes a feedback loop across calls through shared state: _execute_cascade writes each block's regime, and contradicts() reads it when the next block arrives. Reading this as Ashby's double-loop ultrastability is an interpretation, not a measurement.
assessments.assessment: The source distinguishes feedback loops, open loops and the opt-in caller-policy regulator. Maintained tests exercise those contracts. Loop closure on specified numerical/text proxies does not establish external truth, ethical sensing or control robustness.

assessments.statement: The AURA constitutional check, the TRI-AXIAL check and the MICROORCIM daily tracker are open loops in code: each senses and compares, and none acts. The single-pass sovereign pipeline entry point (`SovereignPipeline.run`, `L-PIPELINE`) is feedforward (CASCADE to TRIAD to AURA to stateless MICROORCIM drift); nothing its last stage measures returns to its first, closing only through a person or host model that reads the verdict. The opt-in bounded regulator entry point (`SovereignPipeline.regulate`, `L-PIPELINE-REGULATOR`, SCAFFOLD) closes in code only when supplied an explicit caller correction policy, regulating the implemented coherence and text-score proxy across a finite evaluation budget with visible refusal on budget exhaustion or policy failure (synthetic/internal proxy evidence only; does not establish factual truth or real-world effects).
assessments.assessment: The source distinguishes feedback loops, open loops and the opt-in caller-policy regulator. Maintained tests exercise those contracts. Loop closure on specified numerical/text proxies does not establish external truth, ethical sensing or control robustness.

assessments.statement: An invariant-gated generator (propose candidate actions, admit only those that pass a constraint check) can meet disturbances no rule anticipated, as Ashby's law of requisite variety requires, under two conditions only: the generator has the variety the disturbances demand, and the gate's sensor reads the essential variable rather than a proxy. Without the first it refuses, a visible failure; without the second it admits wrong actions with confidence, a silent failure. Shown in a synthetic toy world; not measured on any language model.
assessments.assessment: The supplied generator/gate example is conditional synthetic evidence, with sensor and variety assumptions explicitly stated. It is not a measurement on a language model.
